meta.name: csdn-blog-publisher
meta.description: Write and optionally publish technical blog posts for CSDN. Single post = full workflow (write + publish). Series/batch posts = write only (save .md locally for manual publishing).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写技术博客并发布到 CSDN,支持单篇发布与批量保存。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常写技术博客并需要发布到 CSDN。
copy.tagline_en: Write technical blog posts and publish them to CSDN, with batch saving as Markdown.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write technical blogs and need to publish them on CSDN.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会按CSDN格式撰写技术博客:先联网搜集资料,再生成约1~2万字的中文长文,带目录、问答、代码示例等,并以「参考文献」结尾;若是单篇文章,还会打开CSDN编辑器,设好标题、封面、标签并发布。
howto.when: 当你要求写一篇并发布到CSDN时触发完整流程(写+发布);当你要求写一个系列或批量文章时,只写并保存为本地.md文件,不自动发布。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于AI Agent的CSDN技术博客,写好后直接发布。
say.note: 走完整流程:查资料、写文、填标题封面标签并发布。

say.text: 给我写一个LLM入门系列,共5篇,先不发布。
say.note: 只写文章并保存为.md文件到本地,供你手动发布。

say.text: 按【Agents篇】格式写第05篇《Agent的规划能力》,先保存为md。
say.note: 按系列模式只写不发布,保存为.md文件。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude writes CSDN-style tech blogs: it researches online, drafts a ~10k-20k Chinese-character article with TOC, Q&A, code samples, etc., and ends with references. For a single post, it also opens the CSDN editor, sets title/cover/tags, and publishes.
howto.when_en: Triggers the full workflow (write + publish) when you ask to write one post and publish it to CSDN. For a series or batch request, it only writes and saves .md files locally, without auto-publishing.

say_en.text: Write a CSDN technical blog about AI Agent and publish it after finishing.
say_en.note: Runs the full flow: research, write, publish.

say_en.text: Write a 5-post 'LLM basics' series, don't publish yet.
say_en.note: Saves .md files locally for manual publishing.

say_en.text: Write post 05 'Agent Planning' in the Agents series format, save as md.
say_en.note: Uses series mode: write only, no publishing.
